permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Reads agent status, approvals and your message list from your own computers over your private Tailscale network.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Lets you speak a prompt to one of your agents. Audio goes only to your own computer, which turns it into text.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Shows the weather for where you are on the top line. Your location goes only to your own computer, rounded to about a kilometer.
